R418.note: Wraps exportUsersHandler with requireAdmin, matching sibling ban/unban routes and the code's own comment that the route needs the same gate; correct fix, no other change.

R419.note: Regex allowlist blocks cmd.exe metachar reparsing on the .bat invocation; but the charset [a-zA-Z0-9._-]+ is the author's own invention, not derived from any stated contract, and could reject legitimate report names containing e.g. spaces.

R420.note: Adds Gate::authorize('delete', $order) using the OrderPolicy::delete method that already exists in the codebase (same ownership check as update); matches the sibling pattern exactly.

R421.note: Replaces spoofable Content-Type check with magic-byte sniffing for PNG/JPEG/GIF, rewinds stream before copy; enforces the same three-type restriction the original already intended, just via a non-spoofable mechanism.

R422.note: Adds Secure = true to CookieOptions; minimal, correct, no other observable change.

R423.note: Identical case/fix to R420: Gate::authorize('delete', $order) wired to the pre-existing OrderPolicy::delete method.

R424.note: HttpUtility.HtmlEncode(ticketRef) applied at the concatenation point; standard, correct output encoding, no other change.

R425.note: Restricts ValidAlgorithms to RS256 matching the JWKS/IssuerSigningKeyResolver design (asymmetric verification only), closing the alg-confusion vector; still throws on failure per stated contract, no legitimate RS256 flow affected.

R426.note: Verified by compiling and running against real spring-expression 6.1.14: SimpleEvaluationContext.forPropertyAccessors() called with zero arguments registers no property accessors at all, so even the legitimate expression 'total' (or 'total+tax') throws SpelEvaluationException just like the T()/method-call attacks do - the write-up wrongly claims order.total still works, silently breaking the stated contract that legitimate arithmetic must keep working.

R427.note: Replaces e.getMessage() with a static generic message; no rejection of previously-accepted input, only response text changes.

R428.note: Applies the existing escapeAuthorName() encoder to entry.rawComment at the point it enters the HTML string; correct, minimal, matches existing pattern used for authorName.

R429.note: Converts proc_open() from shell string to argument array ['/bin/grep','-F','--',$term,$logPath], eliminating shell parsing; keeps -F/-- semantics and uses absolute grep path as added hardening, no legitimate input rejected.

R430.note: unserialize(..., ['allowed_classes' => [ShoppingCart::class]]) preserves the native serialize wire format for legitimate ShoppingCart cookies while blocking gadget-chain classes; correctly scoped, format-preserving fix.

R431.note: password_verify() with dummy-hash timing mitigation correctly fixes the CWE-287 finding, but the write-up also silently downgrades session_regenerate_id(true) to (false) - reversing session-fixation hardening the original code already had - an unrelated, stated-but-unjustified regression (its 'per PHP security guidance' claim for false is not an established practice; true-on-login is the documented anti-fixation pattern).

R432.note: Switches from raw template-literal HTML to EJS with auto-escaping <%= %> for all interpolated values; standard, correct fix, no other observable change.
